controls: Full OOO dependency image sufficiency per carrier in each new gauge.
domain: Reconstruct the degree<=2 kernel and full OOO image from independent whole-state ROLE_CAPPAR/ZOE signatures in each gauge. Do not assume the old 462 dependency basis transports through a state-dependent change of coordinates.

definition.ownerSwap: Swap owner residual families at exact descriptor level, then recanonicalize all role permutations with attached capacity parity. This differs from swapping already-compressed depth histograms.
definition.mover: Apply that descriptor swap to every component exactly when the state's mover is owner1. Mover becomes owner0.
definition.descent: Remaining-capacity parity is XOR of capacity parity over odd-multiplicity descriptors. Mover parity equals (W*H mod2) XOR remaining parity. Check this against source-state rank before interpreting results. The geometry cell-count parity is explicit legitimate rule context.
definition.endpoint: Use the frozen full edge reversal orbit or its capacity-star quotient; no lexicographic endpoint sign is interpreted physically.

freeze: Commit all per-gauge structural snapshots, candidate catalogs and dependency rows before new scalar replay. Replay known training outcomes only, with class-purity and kernel checks; preserve explicit contradiction certificates.
limits: This is trained-data gauge revalidation, not fresh OOO qualification or a universal formula. A gauge-dependent failure is representation-relative evidence, not a game-theoretic obstruction.
